_comment: Guided tour of the Wizards hub. Targets are controls the hub draws: the list ('wizards_list'), the description header ('description'), Help and Guide.

steps.title: The wizards
steps.text: The list on the left holds the guided workflows ChiSurf bundles: the time-resolved anisotropy assistant and the batch analysis. Hover an entry for what it does.

steps.title: Pick one
steps.text: Click an entry. The wizard is built the first time you open it and keeps its state while you look at another one.

await.hint: Click a wizard in the list.

steps.title: The embedded wizard
steps.text: It is drawn on the right under its description. Every wizard has its own Help and Guide buttons: use them for how that wizard is operated.

steps.title: Help
steps.text: Help explains the hub; Guide starts this tour again.
